name: QuotesDone
headline: Open one. Leave the rest sealed.
promise: Describe a job once. Licence-checked UAE suppliers quote it without seeing who you are.

proof.title: Your name stays off the brief.
proof.body: Your name, number and company are removed before any supplier sees the job.

proof.title: Licence-checked suppliers only.
proof.body: Number, issuing authority and expiry are read from the licence itself. An expired licence cannot quote.

proof.title: 3% of the quote you choose.
proof.body: Posting and comparing are free. You pay only to reveal the supplier you pick, and the fee is shown before you pay. If that supplier does not respond within 5 working days, everything you paid is refunded.

statusLine: Live at quotesdone.com, in English and Arabic. Every trade in the UAE except food and beverage, for now.
